Description of Foreigners Suspected of being
Agents of the III International and in Touch
with Chinese Communists.
--------------------------------------------

On November 18, 1932, the Municipal Police discovered
the archives of the National Headquarters of the Chinese
Communist Youth League at House No. 2, Lane 42, Kiaochow
Road, and arrested two Chinese named Zung Ping Woo
(陳炳武) and Zung Ching Zai(莊正才) who were found
on the premises. In the course of interrogation Zung
Ping Woo and Zung Ching Zai disclosed that members of the
Standing Committee of the Communist Youth League used to
receive advice and discuss Communist matters with two
foreigners whose descriptions are as follows :-
(1) Height, over 6'; age, 20 to 25; build, big and
inclined to stoutness; dresses very smartly; face,
thin, long; fresh complexion; few pimples; nose, long
and prominent; hair, brown, parted at left side;
eyes, brown; ears, big and wide; shoulders, wide;
Believed to be Russian.
(2) Height, about 5'9"; slim build; smartly dressed;
long pale face; deep set blue eyes; prominent teeth,
one protruding from upper front set; brown hair en
brosse; wears horn rimmed glasses with golden ear
pieces; Believed to be American.

collaboration with the Chinese Authorities arrested

涉嫌为第三国际代理人并与中国共产主义者有联系的外国人体貌特征描述。
--------------------------------------------

1932年11月18日，工部局警务处在胶州路42弄2号发现了中国共产主义青年团全国总部的档案，并逮捕了在现场的两名中国人，名为 Zung Ping Woo (陳炳武) 和 Zung Ching Zai (莊正才)。在审讯过程中，Zung Ping Woo 和 Zung Ching Zai 透露，共产主义青年团常务委员会成员曾与两名外国人接受建议并讨论共产主义事务，这两名外国人的体貌特征如下：
(1) 身高，6英尺以上；年龄，20至25岁；体格，高大且略显粗壮；衣着非常时髦；脸型，瘦长；肤色红润；少量粉刺；鼻子，长而突出；头发，棕色，左侧分缝；眼睛，棕色；耳朵，大而宽；肩膀，宽阔；推测为俄国人。
(2) 身高，约5英尺9英寸；体格苗条；衣着时髦；脸色苍白的长脸；眼窝深陷的蓝眼睛；牙齿突出，上排门牙中有一颗 protruding（突出）；棕色短发如刷状（en brosse）；佩戴金脚玳瑁框眼镜；推测为美国人。

1933年2月1日，工部局警务处与中国当局合作，在麦赫斯特路（Medhurst Road）56弄5号逮捕了三名共产主义者，分别为 Sung Chi Ling (孫際明)、Wong Yoong Zung (王永成) 和 Yang Peng Tsung (楊本真)，此处为中国共产主义青年团

Youth League had established a new National Headquarters.
Wong Yoong Zung, a Moscow trained Communist, who
at the time of his arrest was the Secretary of the Communist
Youth League, in a statement to the Municipal Police,
asserted that in February 1932 he and an interpreter
proceeded to a certain foreign house on Bubbling Well
Road near Gordon Road, where they met a foreigner with
whom they discussed various phases of Communism and from
whom they received instructions as to how they should
proceed with Communist work. Wong described this foreigner
as follows :-
Height, about 5'8"; stout build; smartly dressed;
age, over 30; dark wavy hair short at the back; wears
glasses; good teeth at the front; broad round face
with a mole on the right cheek; high forehead; dark
eyebrows; big mouth; hairy hands; dark shaven; speaks
English and Russian. Believed to be a Russian Jew.
During January 1933 when Wong Yoong Zung was working
with the Communist Youth League, he and Sung Chi King
met a foreigner in a house on Avenue Joffre near the Cathay
Theatre on several occasions. They discussed Communist
affairs with this foreigner and received from him instruc-
tions and advice regarding the activities of the Party.
The foreigner's description was as follows :-
Height, about 5'7"; slim build, age, between 20 and 25;
smartly dressed; light brown hair en brosse; thick
eyebrows; deep set eyes; good teeth; no glasses; fair
hair on hands; thin long face; fresh complexion; broad
forehead; clean shaven; single shirt cuffs; smokes
cigarettes; nicotine stained fingers; fond of beer.
Believed to be American.
